## Key design decisions
- Production dossier surface lives in `web/` (Astro), rebuilt on P15.1's epistemic
  language + a11y/no-JS baseline. It SUPERSEDES the P06.1 slice renderer
  `exports/src/exports/dossier.py` as the production surface, but does NOT delete it
  (additive/back-compat: keep prior ticket's code + tests + traceability rows).
- Logic/data split mirrors P15.1: pure logic + types in `src/lib/dossier.ts`;
  the worked dossier instance (OKCPD / Oklahoma City) as a committed fixture.
- Three "what we don't know" surfaces (SIG-UI-011): summary (HTML page top), print
  export (print route), API (static `.json.ts` endpoint with `what_we_dont_know`
  at top level).
- Print/PDF path (SIG-UI-013): a dedicated static print route that chunks the twelve
  sections into `.page` blocks, each carrying a footer with the as-of date + permalink
  (mirrors the proven P06.1 pagination); browser print-to-PDF yields a council-ready
  doc. Verified as a real PDF via Playwright `page.pdf()` in Phase 5.
- `next_decision_date` (SIG-UI-014b): pure fn `expiry - notice_window_days` when
  auto-renews; else expiry. Stable wire name `next_decision_date` (consumed by P15.4).
  Appendix example: expiry 2027-04-02, auto-renew, 90d notice -> 2027-01-02.
- Three action blocks (SIG-UI-014a): authorization / termination_mechanics /
  legal_regime. termination_mechanics rendered in "cost and expiry" so next_decision_date
  appears wherever expiry appears (SIG-UI-014b).

## Requirements (spec deliverables)
1. Twelve §39.2 sections in order — SIG-UI-010
2. "What we don't know" in summary + print + API — SIG-UI-011
3. Incompleteness banner (count + absence-not-evidence) — SIG-UI-012
4. Print/PDF: paginated, sources, as-of + permalink every page — SIG-UI-013
5. Every material figure expandable to reconciliation — SIG-UI-014
6. Three action blocks — SIG-UI-014a
7. next_decision_date computed + displayed wherever expiry shown — SIG-UI-014b
8. Appendix B content contract; render `unknown` explicitly — SIG-UI-015

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1 prints to usable PDF w/ sources, as-of, permalink every page (deterministic)
- [ ] AC2 "what we don't know" in summary + print + API (deterministic)
- [ ] AC3 next_decision_date computed from auto-renew+notice, shown wherever expiry (deterministic)
- [ ] AC4 every material figure expands to reconciliation (agentic)
- [ ] AC5 unknown Appendix-B value renders "unknown" not omitted (deterministic)
- [ ] AC6 phase-gate: CI green; new reqs have automated tests; traceability/ADR/risk
